color.note: Themes are the game's eras. Garage (2017–19) is the default; Bedroom (Prologue, 2009–16), Industrial (2020–22) and Campus (Act II, preview) override a small set: surfaces, ink, accent and tape. Set the era with data-theme on the game root.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind panels; carries the blueprint grid.

tokens.name: paper-grid
tokens.usage: Blueprint grid lines on paper, 24px pitch. Decorative only, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles, cards, modals, the top bar and nav.

tokens.name: panel-sunk
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, meter tracks, inset wells inside panels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px panel borders.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dashed row dividers inside lists and tables.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and numbers on paper, panel and panel-sunk. Also the primary action fill and the BTC series.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions and units on paper, panel and panel-sunk (≥4.5:1 on all three).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled action text on panel (≥3.7:1; disabled text is exempt from 4.5:1 but stays readable). Always paired with a written reason.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on the primary action fill (ink).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The era's stamp colour: hashprice series, the active phase marker, rule under screen titles. Never for buttons, never for gain/loss. Bedroom's green accent sits close to series-rival-3; the Prologue has no league table, so they never share a chart.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Handwritten tape labels and the You row in league tables. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Positive money and counts, always with ▲ or +. Teal-blue, not green, so it separates from loss for colour-blind players.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative money and counts, always with ▼ or −. Also danger (liquidation, moratorium).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and marks (margin-call zone, Heat 50–70). Text on panel only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus-visible ring, 2px solid with 2px offset, on every interactive element. ≥3:1 on paper and panel.

tokens.name: series-btc
tokens.usage: BTC price line and bars: solid 1.8px.

tokens.name: series-eth
tokens.usage: ETH price line: dashed 5/3, lighter than BTC so it reads in greyscale.

tokens.name: series-hashprice
tokens.usage: Hashprice line and cost-per-coin price line.

tokens.name: series-you
tokens.usage: The player's series in multi-company charts: the only accent-coloured line.

tokens.name: series-rival-1
tokens.usage: Rival series (Riot). Solid, circle markers.

tokens.name: series-rival-2
tokens.usage: Rival series (Marathon). Solid, square markers.

tokens.name: series-rival-3
tokens.usage: Rival series (Core Scientific). Dashed, triangle markers.

tokens.name: series-rival-4
tokens.usage: Rival series (Bitfarms). Dotted, diamond markers.

tokens.name: series-benchmark
tokens.usage: Benchmark or target lines: dotted 1px. Never text.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heat 0–29: calm. Meter fill only.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heat 30–49: complaints possible. Meter fill only.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heat 50–69: rate-hike events eligible. Meter fill only. Equals the era accent in garage, industrial and campus; bedroom uses amber-brown because its accent is green, and green must never read as a heat warning.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heat 70–89: moratorium. Meter fill plus a hatch pattern.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Heat 90+: shutdown order. Meter fill plus a hatch pattern.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals and event cards.

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: MARKETING ONLY: logo, store capsule, trailer cards. Never in the game UI.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: MARKETING ONLY: logo and store art ground and type.

tokens.name: brand-concrete
tokens.usage: MARKETING ONLY: store art ground behind the logo.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: One per screen: quarter report, Merge, chapter report.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Action rows, event bodies at 15.5px, all running text.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Secondary text inside panels, log entries.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels above numbers. Set text-transform: uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: num-kpi
styles.usage: KPI tiles and big top-bar values.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Top bar, tables, inline figures. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: num-s
styles.usage: Secondary figures, costs in action rows, axis labels.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Handwritten tape and margin notes. At most one per screen (two in bedroom); never for data or instructions.

styles.name: brand-logo
styles.usage: MARKETING ONLY: logo lockup and store art, uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Pip gaps, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside rows and tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel gaps and panel padding (dense).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, modal inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Modal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Report screen padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large screen padding (Merge, chapter).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Title screen spacing.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Tags, badges, default markers.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Modals, event cards, Merge option cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Bandwidth pips, meter tracks, monogram tiles.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Panel borders (line).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Buttons, choice buttons, monograms (ink).

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Rule under the top bar and screen titles (ink).

tokens.name: screen-min-w
tokens.usage: Minimum game viewport width.

tokens.name: screen-min-h
tokens.usage: Minimum height. Steam Deck (800px) adds 80px to the main area, never to the top bar.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: nav-w
tokens.usage: Left navigation width.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Blueprint grid on paper.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height for primary actions and choice buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Event cards and modals only. Panels have no shadow.
